name: walking on elliptical machine v. 7
description: Steady walking motion on an elliptical trainer. It is a low-impact way to raise your heart rate and build endurance.
instructions: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly.
Start moving in a smooth, walking-style stride.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and core braced.
Choose a moderate resistance and keep a steady pace.
Continue for 10 to 30 minutes, depending on your fitness, then cool down slowly.
